headlines.title: בנו של נתנאל שקרון שנרצח בפיגוע ספד לו: "תודה אבא על שהצלת אותי"

Shkaron, who was killed in the shooting attack on Yom Kippur eve, was buried in the settlement of Ali Zahav in Samaria. His son Yoav said, "Thank you Nati for your heroism and for seeing Yoav," while his wife said, "Thank you, Dad, for what you told me and for saving me."

headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Katz warned Hamas, "If an Israeli soldier or civilian is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated." Katz spoke at the state memorial ceremony for the fallen soldiers of the Yom Kippur War, clarifying to Hamas that they would not back down from the red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the strip is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating they had eliminated Khamenei and removed the threat of nuclear annihilation. He emphasized that the work is not finished and they will strike a third time if necessary.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון ז"ל שנרצח בפיגוע סמוך לנווה צוף הובא למנוחות
headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron, who was murdered in an attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest. Family, friends, and residents accompanied Shkaron on his final journey to the cemetery in Ali Zahav. His 16-year-old son Yoav, who was with him during the attack, said goodbye, "Thank you for giving me life." His wife Mirav described him as "the most involved father in the world," and his sister Ruthi called him "a pleasant, wise, and humble person."
headlines.title_he: נתנאל שקרון ז"ל שנרצח בפיגוע סמוך לנווה צוף הובא למנוחות
headlines.snippet_he: נתנאל שרון, שנהרג בפיגוע טרור ליד נווה צוף, נקבר. משפחה, חברים ותושבים השתתפו בהלוויה. בנו בן ה-16, יואב, שהיה איתו במהלך הפיגוע, נפרד מהודה לו על שהעניק לו חיים. אשתו ואחותו חלקו גם הן זיכרונות.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron is the victim of the attack at the Ein Binyamin spring; the attacker was captured in a hospital in Ramallah. A terrorist opened fire on people at the spring near Neve Tzuf, then abandoned his vehicle and fled on foot. Natanel Shkaron, a father of six from Ali Zahav, who had come to immerse himself before Yom Kippur, was evacuated in critical condition to Beilinson Hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Following an extensive manhunt, Duvdevan unit soldiers apprehended the terrorist inside a hospital in Ramallah after he was injured by IDF tracker fire during the pursuit. About an hour later, a second terrorist attempting a ramming attack in the northern Samaria was killed.
headlines.title_he: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
